title: Add a utility function
skill: a small feature in one squad
request: Add a slugify(text) function to src/core/strings.js. It lower-cases the text, trims it, replaces every run of characters that are not letters or digits with a single hyphen, and never leaves a hyphen at the start or end. Example: slugify('  Hello, World!  ') returns 'hello-world'. Text with nothing usable returns ''.

plan.summary: Add slugify() to the core strings module.
